scope: development-only FP32 optimizer-seed stability gate before any QAT stage

metric_contract.aggregation: arithmetic mean of the 1,019 per-query Recall@10 values, evaluated in float64 before any display rounding

outcome_knowledge_at_freeze.disclosure: Seed 42 passed the original single-seed development gate before this replication protocol was frozen. The primary replication decision is therefore driven by the still-unseen seeds 43 and 44; this is not a fully outcome-blind three-seed preregistration.

frozen_training_configuration.epoch_selection: highest inner-validation FP32 Recall@10, with epoch 0 eligible and earliest epoch winning ties

seed_policy.retry_policy: A same-seed retry is allowed only after a documented exogenous interruption that produced no valid TRAINING_COMPLETE artifact. The failed attempt and logs must be retained. Numerical divergence, NaN, deterministic-runtime failure, or any completed poor outcome is not retryable and may not be replaced by another seed.

bundle_materialization.reason: The seed-42 Colab run retained the exact bundle and split-manifest hashes but not the ephemeral bundle payloads. Seeds 43 and 44 therefore require one deterministic re-materialization before either held-out run starts.

allowed_inputs: the exact seed-42 MS MARCO 1M embeddings, document IDs, query vectors, M32 index, PCA sidecars, and RARS-v1 sidecars used to deterministically re-materialize the bound inner bundles
the shared 6,980-query qrels container solely for the inherited builder to construct inner-train and inner-validation labels
the original split identities solely for the freezer's disjointness audit
the re-materialized inner_train and inner_validation bundles only after every registered manifest and split-audit hash matches
the exact frozen PCA basis and PCA configuration bound above
data_access_policy.disclosure: Held-out means unseen optimizer seeds 43 and 44, not held-out queries. The inherited builder necessarily opens and parses the shared 6,980-query qrels payload, including values outside the inner roles, while the freezer reads outer and clean-test identities for overlap auditing. Those values and outcomes may not enter either held-out run, loss, checkpoint selection, comparator, or decision. All three seeds reuse the same 1,019-query development selection split, which also selected each run's epoch. This gate measures development stability and is not independent confirmatory evidence.

per_seed_definitions.positive_support_over_base: count of queries i for which RARS Recall@10(s,i) > Base Recall@10(s,i)
per_seed_definitions.positive_support_over_pca: count of queries i for which RARS Recall@10(s,i) > PCA Recall@10(s,i)

paired_joint_query_bootstrap.population: the 1,019 inner-validation query positions in the identical frozen query order
paired_joint_query_bootstrap.pairing: For bootstrap replicate j, draw one index vector and use that same vector for both held-out seeds and both comparator gains.
paired_joint_query_bootstrap.replicate_statistic: arithmetic mean of the sampled g_base_i values and arithmetic mean of the sampled g_pca_i values
paired_joint_query_bootstrap.lower_bound: NumPy quantile at 0.025 with method='linear' over the 20,000 replicate statistics
paired_joint_query_bootstrap.stability_requirement: both the Base and PCA lower bounds are strictly greater than 0

evaluation_order: Validate all lineage, configuration, query identity, environment, completion, and artifact hashes for seeds 42, 43, and 44.
If validation fails, return INVALID and do not compute a scientific result.
Compute the two held-out mean gains from seeds 43 and 44.
If either held-out mean gain misses its registered threshold, return STOP.
If both held-out mean thresholds pass, evaluate every remaining stability condition.
Return STABLE_GO_TO_QAT only if every stability condition passes; otherwise return UNSTABLE_NO_QAT.
stability_conditions_all_required: all three seeds 42, 43, and 44 satisfy joint_pass, so neither held-out seed may be rescued by the known seed 42 or by the other held-out seed
the held-out paired joint-query bootstrap 95% lower bound over Base is > 0
the held-out paired joint-query bootstrap 95% lower bound over PCA is > 0
seed 43 has at least 11 positive-support queries over Base and at least 11 over PCA
seed 44 has at least 11 positive-support queries over Base and at least 11 over PCA

decisions.STABLE_GO_TO_QAT: The held-out primary thresholds and every stability condition pass. This authorizes freezing a separate QAT protocol; it is not itself a QAT or external-validation result.
decisions.STOP: At least one held-out mean gain is below its registered threshold. Do not enter QAT and do not add seeds or revise the method under this protocol.
decisions.UNSTABLE_NO_QAT: Both held-out mean thresholds pass, but at least one other stability condition fails. Do not enter QAT under this protocol.
decisions.INVALID: Lineage, configuration, data-access, completion, query-identity, environment, or artifact validation fails. INVALID is operational/provenance failure, not a scientific STOP or success.

additional_replication_artifacts_require: copied bundle build summary, split audit, freeze summary, query manifests, and role manifests with a content-addressed audit manifest
the frozen PCA FP32 per-query Recall@10 array in the identical 1,019-query order
a query-identity manifest and SHA-256 shared by every per-query array
a replication environment manifest recording Python, NumPy, Torch, CUDA, Faiss, GPU, cuDNN, driver, determinism flags, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG, and a pip-freeze hash
per-seed positive-support counts over Base and PCA
the 20,000 paired joint-query bootstrap statistics or a content-addressed lossless artifact containing them
a replication manifest containing all three run IDs, all input/output hashes, environment records, computed gains, pass flags, confidence intervals, and final decision
validation_rules: Every training_complete output record must match both byte count and SHA-256.
The seed 43 and 44 fingerprint payloads must differ from the audited seed 42 payload only in configuration.seed.
Base and PCA per-query arrays must have identical query identity and values across seeds.
No decision may be emitted if a required per-query array, query manifest, environment record, or hash is missing.
The seed 43 and 44 metric payloads remain sealed until both runs and their artifact hashes are complete.

audited_seed_42.audit_source: read-only retrieval of the completed Google Drive run followed by byte-count and SHA-256 verification

prohibited_actions: viewing either held-out seed's metrics before both seeds are complete and hashed
adding seed 45 or any replacement seed
selecting the best seed or averaging only successful seeds
changing training, mining, epoch selection, threshold, bootstrap, support, or comparator rules after seeing seed 43 or 44
using this development-only replication as external confirmatory evidence
